summary: Modular Medical, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Placement Agency Agreement with Maxim Group LLC for a registered direct offering of 750,000 common shares at ~$4.50/share, raising ~$3.375M gross proceeds. The offering closed April 21, 2026. A 7% cash fee and expense reimbursement up to $75,000 are paid to Maxim. Directors and officers entered 90-day lock-ups; the Company agreed to a 45-day issuance standstill. The filing is an equity capital return event via a shelf takedown, not a special situation. No further terms or regulatory clocks. Watch for dilution impact on existing shareholders.
